title: Neckapauge (Green's Creek)
summary: Neckapauge is associated with Green's Creek, west of Sayville in the Town of Islip. The name appears in connection with the eastern boundary and beginning bound of the Nicoll Patent.
map_geometry_source: approximate modern Green's Creek / West Sayville marker; not exact Nicoll Patent boundary coordinate
history_content: Neckapauge belongs to the south-shore creek landscape of Islip and West Sayville. Source-specific boundary context is kept in references and review notes.
translation_content:
Neckapauge is compared with a Massachusetts form meaning one, or the first, water-place. The name is analyzed through elements for beginning or one, water, and land or place.

Why Place Names Matter

“Place names are never just meaningless sounds. They give valuable insights into history and provide clues about the country's cultural and social development.”

— Alberta Education, Walking Together: Aboriginal Place Names (n.d.), Culture and Language, opening text
whereintheworld_content: The map placement is an approximate general point for Green's Creek at West Sayville, not an exact boundary point for the Nicoll Patent or a surveyed historical coordinate.
